raw_text: Hi member_001 — I'm member_002, the independent reviewer for REVIEW2. I have no candidate to review yet (published_candidates=0). Please implement the Nominal-scale fix (categorical-like axis: ±0.5 limits, no grid, y-axis inverted), then publish with fix_patch and send me handoff_patch with the patch_id. I will integrate_patch, run_tests on your exact version, and org_review_patch (accept or request_changes with concrete failures). Note: your final working tree is the delivery endpoint, so keep the published patch aligned with your final tree. Ping me when published.

Candidate patch-1 is published for independent review. It implements the issue (Nominal, incl. inferred, drawn like categorical): ±0.5 limits, no grid, y-axis inverted.

Changes: seaborn/_core/scales.py adds Scale._finalize (no-op) + Nominal._finalize override; seaborn/_core/plot.py calls each axis scale's _finalize in Plotter._finalize_figure after user limits.

IMPORTANT test-environment caveat I already confirmed: current-version run_tests on tests/_core/test_plot.py + test_scales.py gives 175 passed / 75 failed, but ALL 75 failures come from a pre-existing pandas incompatibility at plot.py:1478 — pd.option_context("mode.use_inf_as_null", True) raises pandas OptionError "No such keys(s)" inside split_generator, which aborts the plot pipeline BEFORE _finalize_figure runs. So plot-level tests cannot exercise my change here regardless of the patch; all Nominal tests in test_scales.py pass. Please account for this when judging: it is an environment/upstream-pandas mismatch, not a regression from patch-1. If you see the same class of failure, that's expected and not specific to this fix. Please integrate_patch, run_tests, then org_review_patch.

ACCEPTED: patch-1 (review-1). I independently integrated it into my private tree (clean, 2 files) and ran public tests on that exact version v2 (files_sha256 8af5a675...).

Evidence:
- Focused: tests/_core/test_scales.py -> PASSED, 83 collected / 82 passed / 0 failed / 1 xfailed (report test-report-e856258019c6a5761f18b1fe). All TestNominal cases green.
- Combined test_plot.py + test_scales.py -> 75 failed / 175 passed. I diagnosed every failure: pandas OptionError "No such keys(s): 'mode.use_inf_as_null'" raised at seaborn/_core/plot.py:1478 in _plot_layer. That option is gone in newer pandas and the line exists in the untouched baseline (also _oldcore.py:1119, categorical.py:1793). Pre-existing environment incompatibility, NOT a regression from patch-1, and unrelated to the Nominal paths.

Diff check against the issue's three requirements: (-0.5, n-0.5) pinned limits with margins=0 and set_data_interval(..., ignore=True); axis.grid(False, which="both"); ax.invert_yaxis() for y. Base Scale._finalize is a no-op and it is skipped when p._target is not None. Inferred Nominal gets it too. Implementation matches the issue's suggested Plotter._finalize_figure placement.

No changes requested. You own delivery: proceed with your final integration, run_tests on your current version, fix_patch, then submit_integration. Note the full test_plot.py suite will keep showing those pandas failures in this environment; that is upstream of our fix.
